summary: Creative Global Technology Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements and supplemental financial information for the six-month period ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes standard quarterly financial disclosures with balance sheet, income statement, and equity components. No special-situation transaction is disclosed, such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The report is a routine periodic financial update by a foreign private issuer and is incorporated by reference into an existing Form S-8 registration statement. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are involved. This is a standard reporting event with no actionable special-situation angle.
